{{Current events|year=2020|month=03|day=23|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Islamist insurgency in Mozambique]]
**Islamist militants seize the port town of [[Mocímboa da Praia]] in northern [[Mozambique]] after capturing the town's military base in an overnight attack. Residents say militants have blocked all exits in the town. The [[Mozambique Defence Armed Forces]] and police have launched a counter-offensive. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-52005899 (BBC)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**The [[Syrian Air Defense Force]] says that it intercepted a drone near the [[Khmeimim Air Base]]. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-syria-security-attack/syrian-air-defense-intercepts-a-drone-in-the-vicinity-of-syrias-hmeimim-air-base-idUKKBN21A3VQ?feedType=RSS&feedName=worldNews (Reuters)]

;Arts and culture
*[[2019–20 coronavirus pandemic in mainland China]]
**About 500 cinemas reopen in [[China]]. [https://deadline.com/2020/03/china-movie-theaters-open-500-international-box-office-1202890025/ (Deadline)]
*[[Impact of the 2019–20 coronavirus pandemic on television]], [[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Spain]]
**Italian actress and former beauty pageant winner [[Lucia Bosè]] dies aged 89 from a pneumonia complicated by COVID-19, becoming the first cinema star to die during the pandemic. [https://www.billboard.com/articles/columns/latin/9340515/lucia-bose-dead-actress-dies (Billboard)]

;Business and economy
*[[Socio-economic impact of the 2019–20 coronavirus pandemic]]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in the Republic of Ireland]], [[2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
***[[Fast food restaurant]] chain [[McDonald's]] closes all of its restaurants in the [[United Kingdom]] and [[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]] citing the safety of its employees and customers amid the coronavirus pandemic. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/mar/22/mcdonalds-to-close-restaurants-in-uk-and-ireland-on-monday (''The Guardian'')]
**[[Economy of the United States]], [[2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United States]]
***The [[United States Senate]] votes down for a second time a stimulus relief package. [https://fox4kc.com/tracking-coronavirus/watch-live-u-s-senate-votes-on-covid-19-stimulus-bill/ (Fox 4)] [https://www.cnbc.com/2020/03/23/coronavirus-updates-talks-on-senate-stimulus-bill-continue-vote-pushed-to-noon.html (CNBC)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/us-policy/2020/03/23/trump-coronavirus-senate-economic-stimulus/ (Washington Post)]
***The [[Federal Reserve Bank]] announces the commitment to buy any amount of government-backed securities needed to keep interest rates down. Among other measures being developed to support the [[real economy]], it will also establish a special purpose vehicle allowing it to buy investment-grade [[corporate bond]]s directly. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-fed-rescue-analysi/with-latest-moves-fed-becomes-creditor-in-chief-for-u-s-business-idUSKBN21A3JX (Reuters)]

;Health and environment
*[[2019–20 coronavirus pandemic]]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Oceania]]
***[[Vanuatu]] puts the island of [[Aneityum]] under "temporary lockdown" after a [[cruise ship]] with a reportedly infected passenger on board visited the island. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/412385/vanuatu-island-under-lockdown-after-cruise-ship-visit (RNZ)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in New Zealand]]
****New Zealand enters [[New Zealand coronavirus alert level|alert level]] 3 after the investigation into two assumed community-spread cases do not find any links to travel. All schools and public venues are closed. The country will enter alert level 4 on 26 March at midnight local time. [https://i.stuff.co.nz/national/health/coronavirus/120495548/live-pm-jacinda-ardern-to-give-update-on-coronavirus-alert-level (Stuff)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Fiji]]
****[[Fiji]] confirms its third case of [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.fbcnews.com.fj/news/fijis-third-covid-19-case-confirmed/ (FBC News)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Europe]]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Spain]]
****Spain's [[Ministry of Health (Spain)|Ministry of Health]] reports 4,000 new confirmed coronavirus cases, rising to 33,000 infected and 2,182 dead. [https://elpais.com/sociedad/2020-03-23/ultima-hora-del-coronavirus-en-directo.html (''El País'')]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[British Army]] begins [[Operation Rescript]], to assist the [[United Kingdom|UK]]'s efforts to tackle the coronavirus pandemic. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/health/coronavirus-british-army-frontline-nhs-staff-personal-protective-equipment-a9417456.html (''The Independent'')]
****[[Downing Street]] confirms [[Foreign Secretary of the United Kingdom|Foreign Secretary]] [[Dominic Raab]] is the "designated survivor" to replace [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] [[Boris Johnson]] if he became "incapacitated" due to COVID-19. The clarification comes after the issue was raised by MP [[Peter Bone]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/politics/coronavirus-boris-johnson-dominic-raab-prime-minister-a9418246.html (''The Independent'')]
****In a Prime Ministerial broadcast from [[Boris Johnson]], [[England]] is placed in lockdown. Johnson's statements are soon followed by similar measures in [[Scotland]] and [[Wales]]. The new measures close all non-essential stores and ban gatherings of more than two people. [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/live/2020/mar/23/uk-coronavirus-live-news-latest-boris-johnson-minister-condemns-people-ignoring-two-metre-distance-rule-in-parks-as-very-selfish (''The Guardian'')]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in the Netherlands]]
****The [[Netherlands|Dutch]] [[Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport|Health Ministry]] reports 545 new confirmed cases of COVID-19 and 34 more deaths, bringing the total number of cases to 4,749 and 213 deaths. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-netherlands-tally/confirmed-coronavirus-infections-in-netherlands-rise-13-34-new-deaths-idUKKBN21A2C0?il=0 (Reuters)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Cuba]] sends doctors to [[Italy]] to fight the coronavirus. [https://www.reuters.com/video/watch/cuban-doctors-arrive-in-italy-to-battle-idOVC6A2QGB?chan=8gwsyvzx (Reuters)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Asia]]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Uzbekistan]] 
****The [[Government of Uzbekistan|Uzbekistan government]] announces that a lockdown of [[Tashkent]] will begin on March 24. [https://www.nytimes.com/reuters/2020/03/23/world/asia/23reuters-health-coronavirus-uzbekistan-lockdown.html (New York Times)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Myanmar]]
****[[Myanmar]] reports the country's first confirmed cases of COVID-19, the patients are a 36-year-old who had travelled back from the [[United States]] and a 26-year-old returning from the [[United Kingdom]]. [[Panic buying]] is reported in the capital [[Yangon]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/myanmar-confirms-first-coronavirus-cases-12569458 (Channel News Asia)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Africa]]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Tunisia]]
****[[President of Tunisia|Tunisian President]] [[Kais Saied]] orders the [[Tunisian Army|army]] to deploy in the streets to enforce a lockdown in response to the coronavirus. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-tunisia-army-idUSKBN21A2EH (Reuters)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in North America]]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Canada]]
****[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Ontario]]
***** [[Ontario Premier]] [[Doug Ford]] announces that non-essential businesses in [[Ontario]] are to be shut down for at least two weeks. [https://nationalpost.com/news/covid-19-ontario-and-quebec-order-non-essential-businesses-closed-after-spike-in-coronavirus-totals (National Post)]
***** [[Mayor of Toronto]] [[John Tory]] declares a state of emergency for the city of [[Toronto]]. [https://toronto.ctvnews.ca/toronto-declares-state-of-emergency-amid-covid-19-pandemic-1.4864679 (CTV News)]
****[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Quebec]]
***** [[Quebec Premier]] [[François Legault]] announces that non-essential businesses in [[Quebec]] are to be shut down for three weeks. [https://nationalpost.com/news/covid-19-ontario-and-quebec-order-non-essential-businesses-closed-after-spike-in-coronavirus-totals (National Post)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United States]]
****[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Hawaii]]
*****''[[Norwegian Jewel]]'' arrives at [[Honolulu]] after cutting its trip short due to COVID-19 and mechanical problems. No positive cases were confirmed among the passengers and crew members. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/troubled-cruise-ship-2000-passengers-docks-honolulu-69741376 (ABC News)]
****[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Massachusetts]]
*****[[Governor of Massachusetts|Governor]] [[Charlie Baker]] orders all businesses and organizations not providing essential services to close until April 7, effective at noon on Tuesday. Baker states that he is not issuing a stay-at-home order, saying it "doesn't make sense from a public health point of view", but has directed the [[Massachusetts Department of Public Health]] to issue a stay-at-home advisory, limiting public gatherings to 10 people or less. [https://www.wbur.org/commonhealth/2020/03/23/baker-closes-businesses-coronavirus (WBUR)]
****[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in New York]]
*****[[New York (state)|New York]] is expected to be the first state to test the treatment of coronavirus with blood from recovered patients. [https://www.nbcnews.com/health/health-care/new-york-will-be-first-state-test-treatment-coronavirus-blood-n1167136 (NBC News)]

;International relations
*[[United Arab Emirates–United States relations]], [[2019–20 Persian Gulf crisis]]
**The [[United States Marine Corps]] and the [[United Arab Emirates Armed Forces]] hold military exercises amid tensions with [[Iran]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/us-uae-troops-hold-major-exercise-amid-virus-69747021 (ABC News)]

;Law and crime
*[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Ghana]]
**Eight people are arrested at a market in [[Ashaiman]] for violating restrictions while disinfection on the market began. [https://www.ghanaweb.com/GhanaHomePage/NewsArchive/Coronavirus-Mass-disinfection-exercise-conducted-in-Accra-markets-902116 (Ghanaweb)]
*The [[Pacific Gas and Electric Company]] is expected to plead guilty to 84 counts of manslaughter in the [[Camp Fire (2018)|Camp Fire]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/pg-e-plead-guilty-manslaughter-california-camp-fire-n1166471 (NBC News)]
*[[Impact of the 2019–20 coronavirus pandemic on prisons]]
**Rapper-turned-informant [[6ix9ine]] requests a early prison release over fears of COVID-19. [https://www.thedailybeast.com/tekashi69-has-shortness-of-breath-wants-early-release-from-prison-due-to-coronavirus (The Daily Beast)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]]
**[[Bernie Sanders]] wins the [[2020 Democrats Abroad primary|Democrats Abroad]] primary. [https://thehill.com/homenews/campaign/488984-sanders-wins-democratic-abroad-primary (The Hill)]

;Sports
*[[Impact of the 2019–20 coronavirus pandemic on sports]]
**[[Impact of the 2019–20 coronavirus pandemic on the 2020 Summer Olympics]]
***The 2020 Tokyo Olympic Games will be postponed. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/olympics/2020/03/23/olympics-2020-ioc-member-tokyo-games-postponed-dick-pound-coronavirus/2899848001 (USA Today)]
